mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_candle_daily (symbol, candle_date, close, adjclose, currency, synthetic) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{date}, #{close}, #{adjclose}, #{currency}, #{synthetic}) ON CONFLICT (symbol, candle_date) DO UPDATE SET close = EXCLUDED.close, adjclose = EXCLUDED.adjclose, currency = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.currency, price_candle_daily.currency), synthetic = EXCLUDED.synthetic
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(candle_date) FROM price_candle_daily WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
SELECT MAX(candle_date) FROM price_candle_daily WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_nav_daily ( account_id, nav_date, cash, holdings_value, total_value, cost_basis, unrealised_pnl, realised_pnl_cumulative, net_flow, day_pnl, units, nav, estimated ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{date}, #{cash}, #{holdingsValue}, #{totalValue}, #{costBasis}, #{unrealisedPnl}, #{realisedPnlCumulative}, #{netFlow}, #{dayPnl}, #{units}, #{nav}, #{estimated} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, nav_date) DO UPDATE SET cash = EXCLUDED.cash, holdings_value = EXCLUDED.holdings_value, total_value = EXCLUDED.total_value, cost_basis = EXCLUDED.cost_basis, unrealised_pnl = EXCLUDED.unrealised_pnl, realised_pnl_cumulative = EXCLUDED.realised_pnl_cumulative, net_flow = EXCLUDED.net_flow, day_pnl = EXCLUDED.day_pnl, units = EXCLUDED.units, nav = EXCLUDED.nav, estimated = EXCLUDED.estimated
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(nav_date) FROM portfolio_nav_daily WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portfolio_nav_daily WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE account_status <> 'CLOSED' ORDER BY account_id

SELECT (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, SUM(realised_pnl) AS realised_pnl FROM realised_pnl_entry WHERE account_id = #{accountId} GROUP BY (booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY day ASC
